questions.question: You want to set such that when you type Baishakh and drag the fill handle, Excel should produce Jaistha, Aashadh and so on. What will you set to effect that?
questions.explanation: Defining a Custom List (Tools > Options > Custom Lists) lets the fill handle extend Baishakh into Jaistha, Aashadh and so on. Fill Series only works on built-in or numeric/date patterns.

questions.question: Separate chaining involves storing collided elements in separate data structures, typically in:
questions.explanation: In separate chaining, each hash table slot points to a linked list holding all keys that hash to that slot.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a type of database?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Network and distributed databases are recognised database types, whereas 'decentralized' is not a standard database type in this classification.

questions.question: _____ is used to shift processes so they are contiguous, and all free memory is in one block.

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Compaction shuffles memory contents so that processes are contiguous and all free memory forms one large block. Fragmentation is the problem that compaction solves, not the solution.

questions.question: Which of the following is true with regard to the ping command?

options.A: Ping stands for Packet Internet Generator.
options.B: The ping command checks the port level connectivity between source destinations endpoints.
options.C: Ping summarizes the packet loss and round-trip delay between two IP endpoints.
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Ping uses ICMP echo messages and reports packet loss and round-trip time between two IP endpoints. It stands for Packet Internet Groper and does not test port-level connectivity.

questions.question: Merge Sort is an example of which algorithm design paradigm?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Merge sort divides the array into halves, sorts them recursively and merges the results, which is divide and conquer.

questions.question: Which attribute of the <body> tag is used to set the background color of a web page?
questions.explanation: bgcolor sets the page background colour in the <body> tag. background sets a background image and text sets the text colour.

questions.question: What is the typical operating voltage range for TTL logic family?
questions.explanation: Standard TTL runs from a 5 V supply (4.75 V to 5.25 V) and low-voltage TTL-compatible logic runs at 3.3 V, so 3.3 V to 5.0 V is the right range. 5 V to 12 V fits CMOS 4000-series, not TTL.

questions.question: Which ZigBee device is used to transfer data between ZigBee devices?
questions.explanation: A ZigBee Router relays (routes) data between devices and extends the network. The coordinator forms and manages the network, and end devices only talk to their parent.

questions.question: What is the main goal of software quality assurance?

options.A: To eliminate all defects from the software
options.B: To ensure the software is defect-free before release
options.C: To establish and enforce standards and processes to improve software quality
options.D: To test software under different conditions

questions.explanation: SQA establishes and enforces standards and processes so that quality is built into development. Guaranteeing zero defects is impossible, and testing (D) is only one quality-control activity.

questions.question: Open System ________ tends to evolve more quickly than proprietary systems?
questions.explanation: Open systems use publicly available standards, so many vendors contribute to both hardware and software, which lets them evolve faster than proprietary systems.

questions.question: What does the 'https' in a web address indicate?

options.A: The website is hosted on a local server
options.B: The website is a search engine
options.C: The website uses standard HTTP protocol
options.D: The website is secure using encryption

questions.explanation: HTTPS is HTTP over TLS/SSL, so the 's' indicates a secure, encrypted connection. Plain HTTP is the unencrypted protocol.

questions.question: The "inode" in a Unix-like file system is used to:

options.A: Store the contents of the file
options.B: Store the file's name and location
options.C: Store the attributes and metadata of the file
options.D: Store the directory structure of the file system

questions.explanation: An inode stores a file's metadata: size, owner, permissions, timestamps and pointers to data blocks. The file name is stored in the directory entry, not in the inode.

questions.question: What is the primary difference between ROM and RAM?

options.B: ROM is volatile, while RAM is non-volatile
options.C: ROM is used for data storage, while RAM is used for program execution
options.D: ROM stores permanent data that cannot be changed, while RAM stores temporary data that can be read and written

questions.explanation: ROM holds permanent (non-volatile) data such as firmware that is normally not changed, while RAM is volatile read/write working memory. Option B reverses volatility.

questions.question: In XML, which attribute is used to uniquely identify an element?
questions.explanation: An attribute of type ID (conventionally named id) must have a unique value in the document, so it uniquely identifies an element. class groups elements and name need not be unique.

questions.question: The software developed to detect and remove viruses only is called ______________.
questions.explanation: Antivirus software detects and removes viruses. Malware, spyware and adware are types of malicious or unwanted software.

questions.question: Which of the following is an advantage of using arrays?

options.B: Ability to store elements of different data types
options.C: Random access to elements using an index
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Arrays allow O(1) random access by index. Insertion and deletion need shifting (O(n)), and arrays store elements of the same type.

questions.question: Which of the following approaches is used by C++?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Object-oriented languages like C++ follow the bottom-up approach (build classes first, then combine them). Top-down is used by procedural languages like C.

questions.question: An OR gate has 4 inputs. The number of words in truth table will be _______.

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A truth table for n inputs has 2^n rows (words); with 4 inputs this is 2^4 = 16. 8 would be the count for 3 inputs.

questions.question: A website or online platform where individuals or groups regularly publish written content, typically in reverse chronological order, is known as:
questions.explanation: A blog (web log) is a site where posts are published regularly and shown newest first. A social networking site focuses on connecting users rather than serial articles.

questions.question: Which Internet Protocol is responsible for mapping IP addresses to MAC addresses?
questions.explanation: ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) resolves an IP address to the corresponding MAC address on a local network. DNS maps names to IP addresses, not IP to MAC.

questions.question: The term "DFD" stands for?
questions.explanation: DFD stands for Data Flow Diagram, a graphical model of how data moves through a system. The other expansions are wrong.

questions.question: What is the full form of SCADA?
questions.explanation: SCADA stands for Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition, used to monitor and control industrial processes.

questions.question: According to Chomsky hierarchy, which of the following is recognized by Recursively Enumerable language?
questions.explanation: Recursively enumerable languages are generated by Type 0 (unrestricted) grammars and recognised by Turing machines. Types 1, 2 and 3 correspond to context-sensitive, context-free and regular languages.
